name: Oristà (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a white saltire and a red horizontal lozenge at the crossing.
history: The flag was approved on 27 January 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4574 of 16 February 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, light blue, with a white saltire 1/4 of the height thick and the horizontal lozenge formed at the crossing of the saltire in red.

features.role: horizontal lozenge at the crossing of the saltire
